headline: [Deep Strike!] Ukraine Says It Hit [5 Russian Warplanes] at Air Base
sub: Three MiG-31s and two Su-34s damaged
caption:
✈️ Deep Strike! Ukraine Says It Hit 5 Russian Warplanes at Air Base

Ukraine's General Staff said on Wednesday that it struck the Savasleyka air base in Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region, east of Moscow. It said five planes that Russia uses to launch missiles and bombs at Ukraine were damaged.

🔹 Ukraine says the planes hit were three MiG-31 jets, used to fire hypersonic missiles, and two Su-34 fighter-bombers. It says they are out of action "for some time".
🔹 The General Staff said damage checks are still going on and more aircraft may have been hit. Russia did not immediately comment, and the damage has not been independently confirmed.
🔹 On the same night, Russian attacks hit Ukraine's power and gas sites, causing outages in five regions, Ukrainian officials said.

💬 Can long-range strikes change the course of this war? 👇

Sources: Reuters (via Al Jazeera), Kyiv Independent

#GlobalEye #Ukraine #Russia #UkraineWar #MiG31 #NizhnyNovgorod
photo_needed: A Russian MiG-31 or Su-34 military jet (on a runway or in the air), or a Russian air base. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Shock Defeat!] Lille Beat Bayern Munich [2-1] to End Unbeaten Season
sub: Kane-less Bayern fall to 15th in UCL
caption:
⚽ Shock Defeat! Lille Beat Bayern Munich 2-1 to End Unbeaten Season

Lille came from behind to beat Bayern Munich 2-1 in the Champions League in France on Wednesday. It was Bayern's first defeat in any competition this season and Lille's first win of the league phase.

🔹 Dayot Upamecano headed Bayern in front after 15 minutes. Ayase Ueda equalised just after the hour, and four minutes later a shot hit the post and went in off Aleksandar Pavlovic for an own goal.
🔹 Bayern played without Harry Kane, who is out for several months with a serious ankle injury, and Michael Olise, who has a foot problem.
🔹 Bayern drop to 15th in the league phase table with three games left. Lille move to within two points of the knockout places.

💬 Can Bayern still go far in the Champions League without Kane? 👇

Sources: AFP, Bundesliga.com

#GlobalEye #ChampionsLeague #BayernMunich #Lille #UCL #Football
photo_needed: Lille players celebrating, or Bayern Munich players looking disappointed (from the Lille v Bayern match on 25 Nov). A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Storm Alert!] Macy's Thanksgiving Parade Moved to [Saturday] as Storm Hits US
sub: Wind gusts up to 60 mph expected in NYC
caption:
🌧️ Storm Alert! Macy's Thanksgiving Parade Moved to Saturday as Storm Hits US

New York's famous Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been moved from Thursday to Saturday because of forecasts of heavy rain and strong winds, CNN reported, citing a city official. A powerful storm is bringing rain, wind and coastal flooding to the US East Coast on the Thanksgiving holiday.

🔹 The parade will now start at 8:30 am (New York time) on Saturday. In Philadelphia, organisers decided not to fly the parade balloons because of the weather.
🔹 New York Governor Kathy Hochul warned of heavy rain, coastal flooding and wind gusts of up to 60 mph in New York City, Long Island and the lower Hudson Valley. New Jersey declared a statewide state of emergency.
🔹 Coastal flood warnings cover large parts of the East Coast, and the storm comes as more than 80 million Americans travel for the holiday.

💬 Would you still go out to watch a parade in a storm like this? 👇

Sources: CNN, NBC News, ABC News

#GlobalEye #Thanksgiving #MacysParade #NewYork #Storm #Weather
photo_needed: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade balloons in New York, or storm waves / coastal flooding on the US East Coast. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Deadly Blaze!] Fuel Tanker Fire on Cairo Ring Road Kills [At Least 31]
sub: Dozens of cars burnt in Giza
caption:
🔥 Deadly Blaze! Fuel Tanker Fire on Cairo Ring Road Kills At Least 31

A crash involving a fuel tanker set off a huge fire on the Ring Road in the Warraq area of Giza, part of Greater Cairo, on Wednesday evening. Egypt's Health Ministry said at least 31 people were killed and at least 21 were injured.

🔹 More than two dozen cars and motorcycles were burnt. Prosecutors' early count was 27 burnt vehicles.
🔹 Health Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar said the death toll is preliminary. Four injured people are in critical condition with severe burns.
🔹 Prosecutors are carrying out DNA tests to identify the victims, and the cause of the fire is still being investigated. President Abdel-Fattah el-Sisi sent condolences to the victims' families.

💬 How can cities make highways safer for fuel trucks? 👇

Sources: AP, AFP, Reuters, BBC

#GlobalEye #Egypt #Cairo #Giza #TankerFire #BreakingNews
photo_needed: The burnt-out cars and fire scene on Cairo's Ring Road in Giza (25 Nov), or firefighters / emergency crews at the scene. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.
